main_text.p: An si quis tantùm minetur, non autem damnum inferat? Resp. Idem dicendum. Quia potentia actui proxima censetur ipse actus. Argum. l. 1. §. si jusserim. D. Acquir. Poss. l. 2. 3. 4. Cod. Ad l. Cornel de Sicar. l. ult. God. In quibus cauf. in integr. restit. Nec. Et certè melius est nascenti malo occurrere, quàm post exitum frustrà medicinam quaerere. l. 1. Cod. Quand. liceat unic. sine jud. Bartol. in l. 3. D. Just. & jur. Boër. decis. 168. n. 9. Gilhauf. arbor. Crimin. cap. 2. tit. 12. n. 24. Speckhan. contr. jur. cent. 3. class. 2. quaest. 8.

Neque distinguo, uti DD. volunt, an solitus quis fit exe-qui minas, an non. Neque e-nim quispiam se periculo tene-tur objicere. Hic enim pericu-lum subest, justus est metus: cùm qui non solitus exequi minas,

page.notes: The first word "quaerere" carries "Quand." in italics with a superscript-looking underline in the scan; read as italic "Quand." Faint grey text in the bottom-right corner is a digitiser's mark and was left out. A speck in the right margin near line 1 is not printed text. No catchword or signature is visible.
